title: Identity and access
summary: Learners enter the localized authentication route, submit credentials, complete the server-selected verification path, and receive an application session before protected learning surfaces become available.

includes: Authentication route and centred authentication panel
OTP challenge or explicitly enabled local-test direct session
Session cookie, CSRF cookie and server session establishment
excludes: Provider account linking and two-factor settings outside the mounted authentication journey
Any identity behavior not exercised by the current route or cited mutation

capabilities: Complete the verification path returned by the server

actors.label: Identity service
capabilities: Establish the authenticated session after successful verification

flows.title: Sign in
flows.trigger: A learner opens the authentication route and submits credentials.

steps.result: The centred authentication panel is displayed
The server verifies credentials under captcha and strict throttling

steps.action: Return an OTP challenge or the explicitly enabled local-test session path
steps.result: The learner receives a challenge handle or an established session

outcomes: A valid learner receives an authenticated application session
An ordinary production sign-in continues through an OTP challenge

rules.statement: Credential sign-in initiation is protected by captcha and strict throttling before the mutation executes.
The ordinary sign-in path verifies the password, creates an OTP challenge, queues the OTP email and returns the challenge id plus expiry.

A direct local-test session is permitted only for the explicitly configured test account outside production; successful direct completion attaches refresh and CSRF cookies and starts the server session.

surfaces.title: Authentication
surfaces.purpose: Collect sign-in credentials and guide the learner through the server-selected verification step until a session is established.

regions.title: Sign in
regions.summary: A single centred form card owns credential entry and completion feedback.

items.label: Verification status
items.status: credentials ready, pending, OTP required, established or failed

acceptance.statement: Opening /[lang]/authentication mounts exactly the AuthenticationPage and its centred authentication panel.
Valid ordinary credentials produce an OTP challenge whose id and expiry are returned after the email is queued.
When the mutation returns the direct-session result, refresh and CSRF cookies are issued and the application session starts before the response returns.

unknowns.question: Which exact route should each authentication entry context open after session establishment?
unknowns.impact: The page exposes a signed-in callback, but the cited route and mutation do not establish one universal redirect target, so prototypes must show completion without inventing a destination.

unknowns.question: Which sign-up, forgot-password and provider-link modes are simultaneously available in this mounted panel?
unknowns.impact: Those operations exist elsewhere in source, but their complete composition is not proven by the evidence for this stable feature surface.

evidence.claim: The localized authentication route mounts AuthenticationPage.
The authentication page renders one centred form-card panel and reports successful session establishment through signedIn.
signInInit is captcha-guarded and strictly throttled, returns a challenge when required, or attaches cookies and starts the server session for a direct-session result.
The handler verifies credentials, creates and mails an OTP challenge with expiry, while the explicitly enabled local test account can return a direct session.
